faqs.q: What is a digital punch card?
faqs.a: A digital punch card replaces a paper stamp card with a record stored in an app or online account. A business verifies each eligible visit, and the customer sees progress toward the next reward without carrying paper.

faqs.q: How can I create a digital loyalty card for my business?
faqs.a: Choose the action customers must complete, set the stamp count, define a reward your margins can support, and publish. In Stampz, you create the card, assign staff access, and use QR flows to record progress.

faqs.q: Is there a free digital punch card plan?
faqs.a: Yes. Stampz includes a free starter allowance for one loyalty card and limited stamps. Upgrade when you need unlimited cards, campaigns, and branches.

faqs.q: Do loyalty programs work for small businesses?
faqs.a: They work when customers naturally return, the reward is easy to understand, staff apply rules consistently, and the cost is sustainable. Track participation, repeat visits, and redemption cost.

faqs.q: What works best for coffee shops?
faqs.a: Simple item-based programs fit frequent purchase cycles. Test reward math against drink margins and peak-hour speed before copying a large chain.
